title: L2: Empuraan
desc: Stephen Nedumpally, a mystifying leader of the crime world, must lead a double life to protect his world by rekindling some old memories.

title: Odahuttidavaru
desc: Two brothers live in harmony. However, their relationship soon begins to fall apart when the younger brother's wife starts creating clashes between them.

title: Gaja
desc: A cat and mouse chase ensues between Gaja and a rival faction leader over a few startling events. Gaja tries to protect his friend, Krishna, and his lover, Shwetha, who are being targeted.

title: Amrithadhare
desc: Puru and Amritha are a married couple deeply in love with each other. However, they face challenges as they try to balance their conflicting desires in their marriage.
